channel.title: Acromegaly Update
channel.description: Weekly digest of new research on acromegaly — trials, therapies, and clinical updates.
channel.itunes:author: Ethan Weiss

item.title: Acromegaly Update — Monday May 25, 2026
item.description: A network meta-analysis confirms that injectable somatostatin receptor ligands remain comparably effective first-line pharmacotherapy for acromegaly while biochemical discordance after surgery complicates post-operative management — and in the rare disease industry, FDA leadership chaos is rattling investor confidence in companies targeting small patient populations.
item.itunes:title: Acromegaly Update — Monday May 25, 2026

item.title: Acromegaly Update — Monday May 18, 2026
item.description: New proteomic biomarkers could sharpen acromegaly diagnosis beyond GH/IGF-1, while the rare disease industry absorbed a $4.1B M&A deal and confronted a meaningful gene therapy safety-efficacy tradeoff — a tension with direct relevance to future pituitary tumor treatment development.
item.itunes:title: Acromegaly Update — Monday May 18, 2026

item.title: Acromegaly Update — Monday May 11, 2026
item.description: Acromegaly research this week centered on the long-term pharmacology of established therapies — fresh discussion of the ACROSTUDY pegvisomant dataset, a methodology-focused systematic review of pasireotide LAR cost-effectiveness, a real-world Mexican comparison of octreotide LAR vs lanreotide autogel using the SAGIT score, and progress on an oral octreotide formulation — while the broader rare disease industry absorbed a $4.1B Angelini-Catalyst takeover, an FDA reversal on the rare blood cancer therapy Ebvallo, a Phase 3 win for Cytokinetics' Myqorzo in non-obstructive hypertrophic cardiomyopathy, and a setback for Entrada's next-generation Duchenne candidate.
item.itunes:title: Acromegaly Update — Monday May 11, 2026

item.title: Acromegaly Update — Saturday May 9, 2026
item.description: A quiet week on the acromegaly research front (one letter-to-editor only) is more than offset by a loud week in the wider rare-disease industry — capped by Angelini's $4.1B takeout of Catalyst, an FDA reversal that revives Atara and Pierre Fabre's rare-blood-cancer drug Ebvallo, and a setback for Entrada's next-gen Duchenne therapy.
item.itunes:title: Acromegaly Update — Saturday May 9, 2026

item.title: Acromegaly Update — Thursday May 7, 2026
item.description: This week's literature brings a long-term safety confirmation for pegvisomant monotherapy, a head-to-head comparison of first-generation somatostatin analogs using a validated composite score, and new evidence linking acromegaly to hepatic steatosis — alongside cost-effectiveness data for pasireotide and updated pituitary tumor pathology tools.
item.itunes:title: Acromegaly Update — Thursday May 7, 2026

item.title: Acromegaly Update — Monday May 4, 2026
item.description: Two important consensus-level papers from late April 2026 sharpen the standards for acromegaly diagnosis and comorbidity management, incorporating AI-assisted screening, ultrasensitive GH assays, and updated international expert guidance.
item.itunes:title: Acromegaly Update — Monday May 4, 2026

item.title: Acromegaly Update — Tuesday April 28, 2026
item.description: This week's acromegaly literature is headlined by a landmark cardiovascular disease review in *Endocrine Reviews* and a cluster of high-yield JCEM papers covering biomarker-guided therapy, standardized pituitary imaging, patient-reported quality of life, and histological predictors of surgical remission.
item.itunes:title: Acromegaly Update — Tuesday April 28, 2026
